title: Cart
emptyBody: Find a product and choose an option to get started.
priceChanged: The price has changed since this item was added.
unavailable: This item is no longer available.
insufficient: There is not enough stock for this quantity. Reduce it or remove the item.
invalidQuantity: Choose a whole quantity from 1 to 99.
lineLimit: Your cart can contain up to 12 different variants. Remove an item before adding another.
currencyMismatch: Your cart uses a different currency. Clear it before adding this item.
missing: This item is not in your cart.
amountLimit: The cart amount exceeds the supported range. Reduce quantities or remove an item.
resolveIssues: Resolve unavailable items or quantities to see a subtotal.
notReserved: Items in your cart are not reserved. Availability will be checked again at checkout.
limits: Up to 12 different variants, with up to 99 units each.
